title: Health Studies
credential: Bachelor of Arts degree with a major in Health Studies

sourceText.admission:
Admission Requirements

Minimum 30 credits including:

• English Composition (5 credits) with a 2.0 or higher

• An approved health course (5 credits, BHS 201 or other B HLTH course recommended) with a 2.0 or higher

• Recommended: One course in Statistics (5 credits) and one course focused on writing (5 credits)

Transfer applicants must also have satisfied:

• All university admission requirements for transfer or international applicants.

• English Proficiency Requirement: All applicants for whom English is a non-native language may have to provide proof of English proficiency.

rules.sourceText:
Core Coursework (View Course Descriptions): 35 credits total

BHS 201: Introduction to Public Health (if not completed prior to admission into the program)



BHS 210: Community Health Promotion & Communication



BHS 300: Principles of Health Research



BHS 302: Social Dimensions of Health



BHS 305: Introduction to Healthcare Policy & Systems



BHS 403: Introduction to Epidemiology



BHS 496: Fieldwork in Health

Introductory Statistics (if not completed prior to admission into the program): 5 credits total 

UW Bothell Courses: BHLTH 215, BMATH 215, BIS 215, BBUS 215



UW Seattle Courses: STAT 220 or QMETH 201



Or, an approved or equivalent introductory statistics courseMeet with an Admissions Counselor to determine if your statistics course is an approved course





Core Coursework (View Course Descriptions): 35 credits total

BHS 201: Introduction to Public Health (if not completed prior to admission into the program)



BHS 210: Community Health Promotion & Communication



BHS 300: Principles of Health Research



BHS 302: Social Dimensions of Health



BHS 305: Introduction to Healthcare Policy & Systems



BHS 403: Introduction to Epidemiology



BHS 496: Fieldwork in Health





Approved Health Studies Electives (100-400 level): 35 credits total

At least 10 credits must be from Bothell Health Studies (BHLTH) course offerings 





Upper Division UW Electives: (300-400 level): 15 credits total




Total Credits for the Major: 90 credits
